ovh.name: OVH
ovh.steps: OVH Manager → Domain names → your domain → “DNS Zone” tab → “Add an entry”. Pick the type (TXT, MX, CNAME), paste the name as a subdomain (the part before your domain) and the value. For an MX, the priority is asked separately (10).

gandi.name: Gandi
gandi.steps: Gandi dashboard → Domains → your domain → “DNS Records” → “Add”. Type, name (without the domain), value; for an MX, priority 10 goes before the value.

ionos.name: IONOS
ionos.steps: IONOS → Domains & SSL → your domain → “DNS” → “Add record”. Host name = the part before your domain; for a long TXT (DKIM), paste the whole value.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.steps: Cloudflare → your site → DNS → “Add record”. For the tracking CNAME, turn the orange cloud off (proxy “DNS only”). Name = the part before your domain; priority 10 for the MX.

o2switch.name: o2switch
o2switch.steps: cPanel → “Zone Editor” → “Manage” → “Add Record”. Full name with the domain, a trailing dot is accepted; default TTL.

squarespace.name: Squarespace / Google Domains
squarespace.steps: Squarespace → Domains → your domain → “DNS settings” → “Custom records” → “Add”. Host = the part before your domain; for an MX, priority 10 is a separate field.

other.name: Other host
other.steps: Look for “DNS zone” or “DNS records” at your host. Each row of the table becomes a record: the type, the name (often without your domain, sometimes with it), the value as is, and priority 10 for the MX. Don’t touch any existing record.
